msg: Usually you get between 1 to 7 points for the mushrooms (when it's x1.) If a certain colour of gnome gets you more than 5 points you should probably keep picking that gnome. If the amount of points goes below 4 you should try picking the other colour gnome to check if it will get you more points. The same two colours of gnomes are always paired (pink and brown, yellow and red, blue and green, purple and orange) one usually gets more points than the other so you should take note of how many points you get from picking each gnome. If you want to try picking a different colour of gnome than usual, you should do it when the points are x1 rather than x5 so the risk of losing a lot of points is lower.
